types.description: Motor circuit breaker / TeSys GV2 (Deca) / 3-pole thermal-magnetic / 4-6.3 A / rotary handle / no auxiliary block

document.title: Schneider Electric Product data sheet - Characteristics GV2P10 - Motor circuit breaker, TeSys Deca, 3P, 4 to 6.3A, thermal magnetic, screw clamp terminals, rotary handle

modelingNotes: Manufacturer spelling of the reference is 'GV2P10' (no hyphen); the source 'GV2-P10' hyphen is a presentation separator. Device short name GV2P, range TeSys GV2 / TeSys Deca. Product Life Status: Commercialised (no successor substitution).

Verified thermal-magnetic 3-pole motor circuit breaker with rotary handle. Thermal adjustment 4-6.3 A (IEC 60947-4-1); In 6.3 A; magnetic tripping current fixed at 78 A; Ith 6.3 A. Current field 6.3 A is the thermal-adjustment upper bound / conventional thermal current, not an installed trip setting or wire ampacity.

Ue 690 V AC and Ui 690 V AC (Uimp 6 kV) are maximum capabilities across a 230-690 V range; rating.nominal_voltage is intentionally omitted because no application circuit voltage is assigned. Motor power capability 2.2 kW@400/415 V, 3 kW@500 V, 4 kW@690 V AC; Icu 100 kA at <=500 V, 6 kA at 690 V; AC-3 / Category A per IEC 60947-2/-4-1; phase-failure sensitive; suitable for isolation. These conditional ratings are documentation, not automated conductor sizing.

Main terminal markings verified visually in TeSys GV Catalogue 2017 p.9 (symbol DF569068, thermal-magnetic with rotary control): line 1/L1, 3/L2, 5/L3; load 2/T1, 4/T2, 6/T3. Keys 1..6 carry the numeric pole markings; the full IEC dual markings are in each terminal description.

Three poles are mechanically ganged and operated by one rotary handle. Pole functions are switched contacts that do not create permanent conductive shorts. Screw clamp terminals, tightening torque 1.7 N.m; 45 x 89 x 97 mm; 35 mm DIN rail or panel mount.

Base device has no PE/earth, shield, communication or signalling terminal. Auxiliary contact blocks (GVAE/GVAN), under-voltage/shunt trip (D1/D2) and fault-signalling contacts (97/98, 05/06) are separately ordered add-on modules with their own terminals and are not part of this type.

connectionCoverage.notes: Entire physical terminal inventory of the bare GV2P10 is the six main power terminals (three ganged poles), verified against the manufacturer terminal diagram. No PE, shield, communication or signalling terminal exists on the base device; add-on auxiliary/trip/signal modules are separate orders and are not modelled here.
